description: This file is a Markdown document that provides a comprehensive overview and specification for the HDMIOutput HAL interface used in a media platform. It details the interface definition, capabilities, operational behavior, event handling, system context, resource management, and platform capabilities relevant to HDMI output control and configuration.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the capabilities of the HDMI output resource, including supported formats, resolutions, colour spaces, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other features.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration specifying different HDR output modes supported.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities profile of the HDMI output, including supported video modes, colour spaces, HDCP versions, HDR modes, and other features.

methods.name: getHDCPCurrentVersion
methods.description: Returns the current negotiated HDCP version.

methods.name: getHDCPReceiverVersion
methods.description: Returns the HDCP version supported by the sink device.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the HDMI output resource, releasing hardware and software resources.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Initializes and prepares the HDMI output resource for use.
